title: Titanium Dive Watch Case
alloyReason: Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5) offers the best balance of high strength (yield >830 MPa), excellent fatigue resistance, and corrosion resistance for precision-machined components. Its strength-to-weight ratio is 45% better than steel, making it the most widely used titanium alloy in aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)

faq.q: What is a titanium dive watch case?
faq.a: A titanium dive watch case is a precision-machined wearable hardware component used in professional dive watch case body >40mm. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is the surface finish achieved on titanium dive watch case?
faq.a: Titanium Dive Watch Case receives PVD coating (ISO 27874, Delta-E <=1.0 color accuracy) for wear resistance and aesthetics, plus oleophobic AFP nano-coating (water contact angle >110 deg) to resist fingerprints and skin oils.

faq.q: What CNC equipment is used for titanium dive watch case?
faq.a: Titanium Dive Watch Case is machined on 5-axis CNC equipment with high-pressure coolant (1000 psi) to manage titanium's low thermal conductivity and work-hardening tendency. Tolerances of +-0.01mm are standard.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium dive watch case?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium dive watch case?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
